page_title: LOR 1-2 STR | Lorient v Strasbourg 17/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+14' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+13' Lorient get a corner.
90+10' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
90+4' The game is interrupted. Lebo Mothiba (Strasbourg) suffers a horrific injury!
90+1' Isaak Toure (Lorient) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
90' Isaak Toure (Lorient) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Bastien Dechepy has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
89' Patrick Vieira prepares a substitution. Habib Diarra is replaced by Jessy Deminguet (Strasbourg).
86' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Strasbourg was in an offside position.
84' Substitution. Dilane Bakwa walks off the pitch and Angelo (Strasbourg) comes on as a substitute.
84' Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle after Sirine Doucoure (Lorient) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
84' Sirine Doucoure (Lorient) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
83' The shots on goal statistics – 1:7.
79' It is time for a substitution. Theo Le Bris (Lorient) is on for Julien Ponceau.
79' Regis Le Bris has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) replacing Bonke Innocent.
78' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Bastien Dechepy no option but to blow his whistle.
76' Substitution. Kevin Gameiro leaves the pitch and is replaced by Lebo Mothiba (Strasbourg).
76' Emanuel Emegha will be replaced by Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg).
72' Here is a change. Benjamin Mendy is going off and Regis Le Bris gives the last tactical orders to Darlin Yongwa (Lorient).
72' Substitution. Aiyegun Tosin makes his way off the pitch and Sirine Doucoure (Lorient) comes on as his replacement.
71' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) receives a yellow card.
71' Matz Sels (Strasbourg) goes into the book and receives a yellow card.
70' Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
68' Lucas Perrin (Strasbourg) is given a yellow card.
67' Patrick Vieira is forced to make a change. Abakar Sylla is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Saidou Sow (Strasbourg).
66' The Lorient players are exchanging some short passes.
65' A pass by Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
62' The game is interrupted now, Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
62' It looks like Isaak Toure (Lorient) saw red with that tackle. Bastien Dechepy won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
61' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lorient, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
61' Bastien Dechepy interrupts the game. One of the players from Strasbourg won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
57' The free kick from Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) is cleared away from danger by one of the defenders.
57' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
56' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) takes the corner.
56' An attempted cross from Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) is cleared. The ball goes behind for a corner. Lorient will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
55' The manager makes a subsitution with Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) coming on for Bamba Dieng.
53' 1 - 2 Goal! Bamba Dieng (Lorient) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 1:2.
52' The ball is cleared after Romain Faivre (Lorient) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

49' Goal! Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a brilliant pass and fires a first-time shot into the bottom right corner. Emanuel Emegha assisted in the goal. 0:2.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
45+2' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the top of the net, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Yvon Mvogo.
45+2' Isaak Toure (Lorient) and Benjamin Mendy attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' A decent cross gives Isaak Toure (Lorient) a chance to score, but he sends his header inches over the bar from close range.
41' Bamba Dieng (Lorient) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
40' A cross from Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
40' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

40' Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Lorient will have a chance to score from a corner.
37' Patrick Vieira is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) suffers an injury and Marvin Senaya comes on.
36' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Romain Faivre (Lorient) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
35' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) commits a rough foul. Bastien Dechepy stops the game and makes a call.
34' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
32' That's a clear yellow card. Bamba Dieng (Lorient) goes into the book.
31' Lorient concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
29' Romain Faivre (Lorient) serves up a nice cross, but Matz Sels punches the ball away.
27' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
25' Romain Faivre (Lorient) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
24' Lorient are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
19' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) will take a corner kick.
19' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lorient.
18' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
17' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lorient comes to nothing. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lorient.
16' A long pass, executed by Habib Diarra (Strasbourg), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
16' Great teamplay by Strasbourg as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
14' 0 - 1 Goal! Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) latches on to an accurate pass and quickly strikes a low effort inside the right post.
13' Yvon Mvogo reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) towards the roof of the net.
13' Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
13' Bastien Dechepy couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Isaak Toure (Lorient) and blew his whistle. Strasbourg have been awarded a free kick.
11' A cross by Romain Faivre (Lorient) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
8' The game is interrupted. Romain Faivre (Lorient) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
1' Strasbourg control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Strasbourg will have the kick-off.
Bastien Dechepy is introduced as the referee for today's match.
